{{Otheruses|Hatchet}}
A '''hatchet''' was a hand-wielded weapon.<ref name="The Ewoks Join the Fight">[[The Ewoks Join the Fight (storybook)|''The Ewoks Join the Fight'' storybook]]</ref>

{{Weapon-stub}}

==History==
[[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] used hatchets, among other weapons such as [[Club/Legends|clubs]] and [[Arrow/Legends|arrows]], against [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].<ref name="The Ewoks Join the Fight" />
